fact: The ICR says the PTMP MIS was fully operational by 2018, all cash-transfer payments were digital through mobile money (94% on time), the first RSU MIS version was delivered in December 2023, and the registry and targeting tools serve other programmes such as the CMU's RAM.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report, Côte d'Ivoire - Productive Social Safety Net Project (ICR00006568)
